# cloudsmith_repository_upstream (Resource)

The repository upstream resource allows the management of upstreams for a Cloudsmith repository. Using this resource, it is possible to proxy and/or cache packages hosted in one or more third-party package registries through a single Cloudsmith repository.

See [docs.cloudsmith.com](https://docs.cloudsmith.com/tbc/upstream-proxying-and-caching#supported-formats) for full upstream proxying documentation.

[Strict mode](https://docs.cloudsmith.com/supply-chain-security/strict-mode) holds packages until security checks are complete and policies have been evaluated, so every download is checked, including the first. Cloudsmith enables strict mode for your workspace. For upstreams, it applies only to those with `mode` set to `Cache Only`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Cloudsmith Ltd 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "cloudsmith_organization" "my_organization" {
  slug = "my-organization"
}

data "cloudsmith_repository" "my_repository" {
  namespace  = data.cloudsmith_organization.my_organization.slug_perm
  identifier = "my-repository"
}

resource "cloudsmith_repository_upstream" "gradle_distributions" {
  name            = "Gradle Distributions"
  namespace       = data.cloudsmith_organization.my_organization.slug_perm
  repository      = resource.cloudsmith_repository.my_repository.id
  upstream_type   = "generic"
  upstream_url    = "https://services.gradle.org"
  upstream_prefix = "distributions"
}

# Strict mode applies only to Cache Only upstreams. The first download of each
# package waits until it has been cached and evaluated against your policies.
resource "cloudsmith_repository_upstream" "npmjs" {
  name          = "npmjs"
  namespace     = data.cloudsmith_organization.my_organization.slug_perm
  repository    = data.cloudsmith_repository.my_repository.slug_perm
  upstream_type = "npm"
  upstream_url  = "https://registry.npmjs.org"
  mode          = "Cache Only"
}

# GitHub skills upstreams require a GitHub access token and Cache Only mode.
variable "github_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "cloudsmith_repository_upstream" "github_skills" {
  name          = "Official Claude plugins"
  namespace     = data.cloudsmith_organization.my_organization.slug_perm
  repository    = data.cloudsmith_repository.my_repository.slug_perm
  upstream_type = "skills"
  upstream_url  = "https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official"
  mode          = "Cache Only"
  auth_mode     = "Token"
  auth_secret   = var.github_token
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A descriptive name for this upstream source. A shortened version of this name will be used for tagging cached packages retrieved from this upstream.
- `namespace` (String) The Organization to which the Upstream belongs.
- `repository` (String) The Repository to which the Upstream belongs.
- `upstream_type` (String) The type of Upstream (docker, nuget, python, ...)
- `upstream_url` (String) The URL for this upstream source. This must be a fully qualified URL including any path elements required to reach the root of the repository.

### Optional

- `auth_certificate` (String, Sensitive) The X.509 Certificate (PEM encoded) to use for mTLS authentication against the upstream (Docker only). Use the file() function to read this from a file.
- `auth_certificate_key` (String, Sensitive) The Certificate private key (PEM encoded) to use for mTLS authentication against the upstream (Docker only). Use the file() function to read this from a file.
- `auth_mode` (String) The authentication mode to use when accessing this upstream.
- `auth_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret to provide with requests to upstream.
- `auth_username` (String) Username to provide with requests to upstream.
- `component` (String) (deb only) The component to fetch from the upstream.
- `contents` (String) (skills only) The package types that the upstream indexes. Valid values are `Skills`, `Plugins`, and `Skills and plugins`. If you leave it unset, Cloudsmith uses `Skills and plugins`, which is the only value that GitHub upstreams accept.
- `distro_version` (String) (rpm only) The distribution version that packages found on this upstream will be associated with.
- `distro_versions` (Set of String) (deb only) The distribution versions that packages found on this upstream will be associated with.
- `extra_header_1` (String) The key for extra header #1 to send to upstream.
- `extra_header_2` (String) The key for extra header #2 to send to upstream.
- `extra_value_1` (String) The value for extra header #1 to send to upstream. This is stored as plaintext, and is NOT encrypted.
- `extra_value_2` (String) The value for extra header #2 to send to upstream. This is stored as plaintext, and is NOT encrypted.
- `include_sources` (Boolean) (deb/rpm only) When true, source packages will be available from this upstream.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether or not this upstream is active and ready for requests.
- `mode` (String) How this upstream delivers packages. Valid values are `Proxy Only`, `Cache and Proxy`, and `Cache Only`. If you leave it unset, Cloudsmith uses `Proxy Only`. `Proxy Only` proxies requests through to the upstream to match packages that aren't in this repository. `Cache and Proxy` proxies the first request for a package through to the upstream, then caches the package in this repository for later requests. `Cache Only` never proxies requests: Cloudsmith holds a request for a package that isn't in this repository yet until the package has been cached and evaluated against your policies, then serves it from this repository. Strict mode applies only to upstreams set to `Cache Only`. Nix and Swift upstreams don't support `Cache Only`. Entitlement tokens with visibility restrictions can't download packages from `Cache Only` upstreams.
- `priority` (Number) Upstream sources are selected for resolving requests by sequential order (1..n), followed by creation date.
- `trust_level` (String) The trust level for this upstream. Supported for Maven, npm, and Python upstreams.
- `upstream_distribution` (String) (deb only) The distribution to fetch from the upstream.
- `upstream_prefix` (String) (generic only) A unique prefix used to distinguish this upstream source within the repository. Requests including this prefix are routed to this upstream.
- `verify_ssl` (Boolean) If enabled, SSL certificates are verified when requests are made to this upstream. It's recommended to leave this enabled for all public sources to help mitigate Man-In-The-Middle (MITM) attacks. Please note this only applies to HTTPS upstreams.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp at which the Upstream was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `slug_perm` (String) The unique identifier for this Upstream.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp at which the Upstream was updated.
